Quick answers up front:
- Sequencing: Redwood can sign the DPA with tracked redlines once legal confirms the UK Addendum and TIA placeholders. If any material TIA changes are required, we'll handle via a short amendment/acknowledgement.
- Subprocessor SLA carveout for EU onshore fallback: we can commit to an operational SLA for residency fallback (99.9% availability for onshore processing within the EU region) and a contractual subprocessor attestation process. Kimberly will own the subprocessor attestation and evidence.
